plugins.name: junk-drawer
plugins.description: Cheatsheet of the whole marketplace: every plugin with its version, description, and commands + params. Run /junk-drawer.

plugins.name: junkd
plugins.description: Handoff, orch, tldr, ctx-limit, ctx-tokens and the status line in one plugin, every command /junkd:<name>: /junkd:handoff and /junkd:handon save and resume a session, /junkd:ahandoff hands off at a context threshold; /junkd:orch runs the orchestration loop (/junkd:orch-init first) with a main-loop guard on Fable; /junkd:tldr summarizes or keeps replies terse; /junkd:ctx-limit guards the context size, /junkd:ctx-tokens reads it; /junkd:statusline wires a colored status line. /junkd opens the junkd, handoff, orch and statusline tabs: the marketplace's plugins, every setting group and the commands. The hooks module exports $.junkd for other mods.
